original.statement: A new spec.profile field was added to the acme.cert-manager.io/v1 Order CRD schema (present in the v1.18.0 CRD bundle, absent in v1.17.0).

decision.reason: The validators confirm from the v1.17.0 [ev-60054fcf0986] and v1.18.0 [ev-9b6164ce0df7] CRD bundles that spec.profile is new in the acme.cert-manager.io/v1 Order schema. The consequence for a purely additive field is none. Because no environment can already be setting a field that did not exist, the only environments the change touches are those that use the Order v1 kind, which is what gvk-in-use{acme.cert-manager.io, v1, Order} expresses. The canonical validator has no standard shape for this case, so this is a judgement call rather than a proof, and confidence is low.
